education_adaptation_cards.title: Teacher Card With Premature Approval
education_adaptation_cards.purpose: Exercise the local-review-only boundary for human review states.

risks.risk_text: A fixture could claim internal approval before the separate human approval flow exists.
risks.mitigation: Reject approved statuses in local review fixtures.

review_notes: This status should be rejected by the validator.

outputs.description: Draft-only lesson outline attached to review packet.

education_adaptation_cards.title: Student Control Card
education_adaptation_cards.purpose: Keep the invalid fixture otherwise structurally complete.

source_binding.blocked_claims_policy: Prompts may ask questions, but cannot state new facts beyond packet sources.

adaptation_actions: Rewrite key claims as discussion questions.

risks.risk_text: Students may treat draft packet claims as settled facts.
risks.mitigation: Preserve draft-only labels and include source-check questions.

education_adaptation_cards.title: Assessment and Gate Control Card
education_adaptation_cards.purpose: Keep the invalid fixture otherwise structurally complete.

source_binding.blocked_claims_policy: Fail the gate if the card contains factual claims without packet source support.

adaptation_actions: Check source coverage for every factual claim.

risks.risk_text: Education cards could be rendered without an explicit gate result.
risks.mitigation: Require this assessment_gate_card before packet integration.

assessment_gates.gate_name: Source support present for every claim
evidence_required: Source ledger IDs for all factual claims
